title: Customer enablement runway for VPC & on-prem security integrations (RBAC / Audit / KMS)
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Objective: deliver a coordinated enablement runway so customers can adopt VPC and on-prem Private installations with RBAC, audit logging, and KMS integration without operational friction. This ticket covers release notes coordination, enablement content, cross-team GTM tasks, and staged decisions for BYOK vs Redwood-managed KMS.

Scope:
- Release notes and migration guidance for RBAC, tenant-scoped audit logs, and KMS integration.
- Enablement artifacts: quickstart runbook, customer checklist, admin walkthrough slides, and a one-hour live webinar.
- Internal enablement: Support runbook, SRE on-call playbook, and escalation matrix.
- Cross-team tasks: Docs, Console UX shipping notes, SDK sample code, Marketplace listing updates, and legal/compliance sign-off.

Acceptance criteria:
- Public release notes drafted and approved by PM + Docs + Legal.
- Admin guide and step-by-step KMS onboarding doc published to Confluence and included in customer docs.
- Support SDR/SE playbook created with example RBAC policies and common troubleshooting flows.
- Two pilot customers onboarded in staging with end-to-end RBAC + audit + BYOK workflows validated.
- Telemetry: key dashboard widgets (audit event rate, KMS errors, RBAC policy violations) created in Console.

Decisions & trade-offs:
- Phased KMS approach: ship Redwood-managed KMS for GA to minimize customer friction; BYOK (customer KMS/HSM) supported in a follow-up opt-in release (trade-off: speed-to-market vs earliest compliance coverage). Decision recorded and approved by Security and Legal on 2026-02-22.
- RBAC model: adopt role-first policies compatible with both Console and API management endpoints. Avoid introducing resource-scoped RBAC v1 that would require large migration.

Rollout plan (high level):
1) Week -2: Internal beta with SRE & Support; gather runbook gaps.
2) Week -1: Pilot customers (2) in staging; iterate docs and console hints.
3) GA: Public release notes, Console UI toggles, docs, and webinar.
4) Post-GA (+2 weeks): BYOK opt-in docs and enterprise workshop.

Comms & Release Notes owner: documentation@redwood.com (primary: Mei Rodriguez). PM to own cross-team sync and publication date.

Artifacts & Links:
- Confluence draft: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/PRIV/PM-9203+-+Enablement+Runway
- Admin runbook draft: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c_enablement_runbook
- GitHub sample code: https://github.com/redwood-inference/enterprise-examples/pull/284
- Telemetry dashboard (Console prototype): https://console.redwood.com/dashboards/private-security-telemetry

Open risks:
- BYOK engineering timeline may slip (current dependency ENG-7120). Mitigation: feature-gate BYOK in GA and prioritize Redwood-managed flow.
- Support capacity during initial rollout; plan to add dedicated SE hours for first 3 pilot customers.

Follow-ups (post-GA):
- Formalized audit retention SLA requests and pricing proposal (PM + Finance).
- Expand RBAC policy templates for industry verticals (HC, FinServ).
- Measure activation funnel and time-to-configure KMS/RBAC; run a usability session.
